description: Each year's emissions of all greenhouse gases, in carbon dioxide equivalent, split into six sectors that do not overlap and add up to the total: energy, industrial processes and product use, agriculture, land use (net, which can be below zero where forests take up more carbon than land clearing releases), waste and other, as published by FAO for the world and each country since 1990. The world's total also counts international aviation and shipping, shown as a part of its own; no country's does. Food is not a further sector: its emissions run across agriculture, land use, energy, industry and waste. Where FAO publishes no row for a sector (27 territories in the November 2026 release, whose energy, industry and waste are counted in their parent country; Tokelau and Nauru in part) the sector is left missing, never set to zero, so for those 27 territories the total is agriculture plus land use only. For 8 of them (American Samoa, Gibraltar, Greenland, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Norfolk Island, Pitcairn, and Svalbard and Jan Mayen) FAO prints agriculture, land use and the total as exactly 0 in some or all years, where it has no estimate. These territories' values are not comparable with countries'.

processing.description: Read Emissions_Totals_E_All_Data_(Normalized).csv from FAOSTAT's Emissions totals (GT) bulk zip. The vintage is the domain's DateUpdate, 6 November 2026, from FAOSTAT's bulk-download catalogue (datasets_E.json), whose entry names this zip and gives FileRows 2,498,428, the number of data rows in this file. The zip was last modified on the server on Fri, 06 Nov 2026 17:13:13 GMT.

Kept the "FAO TIER 1" rows of element "Emissions (CO2eq) (AR5)" (code 723113) for the six IPCC sector items "Energy" (6821), "IPPU" (6817), "IPCC Agriculture" (1711), "LULUCF" (1707), "Waste" (6818), "Other" (6819), and "International bunkers" (6820), in kilotonnes of CO₂-equivalent (IPCC AR5 100-year global warming potentials). Rows from FAO's "UNFCCC" source are not used.

FAO counts "International bunkers" (item 6820: fuel for international flights and voyages) in the "All sectors with LULUCF" total of WLD 1990–2024, and of no other area: there it is published as a part of its own, "International aviation and shipping", so the parts add up to the total. No country's total includes it.

Kept each sector's values for the years in which FAO publishes the area's "All sectors with LULUCF" total (item 6825; 1990–2024 for the World), so the sectors of every published year make up a published total. 5,481 sector values of area-years without a total are left out, all from 1961–1989, before FAO's land-use and all-sector series begin.
Checked in every area and year that the parts present add up to "All sectors with LULUCF" within 0.001 kt (the rounding of the printed values); the transform stops otherwise.

FAO publishes no row for some parts of some areas' all-sector totals. Those parts are left missing, never filled or set to zero, and the published total of those areas is the sum of the parts that exist. ASM, BMU, CYM, ESH, FLK, FRO, GIB, GLP, GRL, GUF, GUM, IMN, MSR, MTQ, MYT, NCL, NFK, PCN, PRI, PSE, PYF, REU, SPM, VIR, WLF: no Energy (item 6821 "Energy") (1990–2024); Industrial processes and product use (item 6817 "IPPU") (1990–2024); Waste (item 6818 "Waste") (1990–2024); Other (item 6819 "Other") (1990–2024). MNP: no Energy (item 6821 "Energy") (1991–2024); Industrial processes and product use (item 6817 "IPPU") (1991–2024); Waste (item 6818 "Waste") (1991–2024); Other (item 6819 "Other") (1991–2024). NRU: no Other (item 6819 "Other") (1990–2024). SJM: no Energy (item 6821 "Energy") (1990–2024); Industrial processes and product use (item 6817 "IPPU") (1990–2024); Agriculture (item 1711 "IPCC Agriculture") (1990–2024); Waste (item 6818 "Waste") (1990–2024); Other (item 6819 "Other") (1990–2024). TKL: no Energy (item 6821 "Energy") (1990–2024); Other (item 6819 "Other") (1990–2024).

FAO prints a "All sectors with LULUCF" total of exactly 0 kt, with every sector it prints for that area and year also 0, for 202 area-years of 8 territories: ASM 2016–2024; GIB 2001–2024; GRL 1996–2001; GUM 1991–2010, 2016–2024; MNP 1991–2010, 2016–2024; NFK 1990–2024; PCN 1990–2024; SJM 1990–2024. They are published as printed, not removed. Their totals cover agriculture and land use only, and a 0 there is where FAO has no estimate, so these values are not comparable with countries' totals.

Left out former states and territories reported only before their dissolution, with no entity here (Belgium-Luxembourg, Czechoslovakia, Ethiopia PDR, Pacific Islands Trust Territory, Sudan (former), USSR, Yugoslav SFR); FAO regional and analytical groups (Africa, Americas, Annex I countries, Asia, Australia and New Zealand, Caribbean, Central America, Central Asia, China, Eastern Africa, Eastern Asia, Eastern Europe, Europe, Land Locked Developing Countries (LLDCs), Least Developed Countries (LDCs), Low Income Food Deficit Countries (LIFDCs), Melanesia, Micronesia, Middle Africa, Net Food Importing Developing Countries (NFIDCs), Non-Annex I countries, Northern Africa, Northern America, Northern Europe, OECD, Oceania, Polynesia, Small Island Developing States (SIDS), South America, South-eastern Asia, Southern Africa, Southern Asia, Southern Europe, Western Africa, Western Asia, Western Europe). Their values are never re-assigned to other entities.
Converted kilotonnes to billion tonnes by dividing by 1,000,000 (exact decimal arithmetic on the printed values).
Every value used carries FAO's flag E, which the file's codebook defines as "Estimated value".

scope.basis: FAOSTAT's six IPCC sectors: energy, industrial processes and product use, agriculture, land use, land-use change and forestry (net: emissions from deforestation, drained organic soils and fires minus the carbon taken up by existing forests, so it can be negative), waste and other. International aviation and shipping (bunker fuels) are counted in the World's total only, as a part of their own, since FAO's release of 6 November 2026; no country's total includes them. Agriculture and land use are FAO's own Tier 1 estimates; energy, industry, waste and other are PRIMAP-hist v2.8 third-party estimates, which count some territories inside their parent country (for example Bermuda in the United Kingdom, Greenland and the Faroe Islands in Denmark, Palestine in Israel, Puerto Rico in the United States). So such a parent country's energy, industry, waste and other emissions include those territories while its agriculture and land use do not, and for 27 territories in the November 2026 release FAO has no energy, industry, waste or other rows, so their total covers agriculture and land use only. Estimates, not country inventory submissions.
scope.geography: The world, countries and territories, and the European Union (27)
